text:
jordan: heads-up — i'm scheduling a kernel attention variant sweep tomorrow 09:00 PT. need 2 GPU slots (A100), one microbench slot for p50/p99, and someone to set nvprof/nvtx tracing. pinging bench team. here's the command i'll use:

```bash
./bench/run_sweep --model=gpt-medium --seq=2048 --batch=1 --variants=flash,v2,paged-fuse --iters=200
```

rachel: can you add the exact seed & env? also is this full-token gen or perf-only forward? :thinking:

jordan: perf-only (no sampling). seed not needed. env: CUDA=12.1, TF_FORCE=0, USE_FLASH=1, LD_PRELOAD=/opt/rocm/lib/libtogether.so

lee: i can take nvtx traces on the first slot. can you drop a minimal repro snippet? i'll bring nsight.

jordan: thanks! repro for nvtx attach:

```py
# run with NVTX
from runtime import run
with nvtx.annotate("layer"): run(step=1)
```

sam: booking two A100s in the bench queue for 9am PT, test id bench/attn-2043

maya: small ask — can we also capture kv-cache allocs? last run had mem spike on tail tokens.

jordan: yes, adding --trace-kv and heap snapshots. will post perf dashboard link after runs. if anyone wants to run a canary earlier lmk.

ci-bot: bench job queued: bench/attn-2043 (A100x2) ETA 00:12

rachel: also FYI i pushed a tiny patch to avoid an extra memcpy in fused path — PR #3184. would appreciate a quick review before runs.

lee: will review by EOD, if it's small we can include in the sweep.

sam: noted, if PR in then we'll run both with and without to compare.

maya: thx. last thing — please capture p95 mem and top-3 kernels by time.

jordan: done. i'll post results in this thread + a short summary table. thanks all :pray:
